library.name: Poznań City Library
library.description: A bustling and well-known library in the heart of Poznań, filled with books and study spaces.

office_building.name: City Office Building
office_building.description: The building where corrupt officials keep important documents.

key-necronomicon.name: Library Key
key-necronomicon.description: A sturdy key designed to open the library doors and access its secret rooms. The key is kept in a secure locker by corrupt officials.

necronomicon.name: Necronomicon
necronomicon.description: An ancient tomes that contains forbidden knowledge and powerful rituals.
necronomicon.image_prompt: antique tomes, dark green covers with strange symbols on them

biographer.name: The Biographer
biographer.description: A young biographer tasked with writing a chapter about the Necronomicon for their university textbook.

dialogues.before_talk: Librarian: There's something missing from your Necronomicon chapter. Did you find it?
dialogues.after_talk: Librarian: I'm going to need some proof that you've seen the necronomicon. You'll have to look a bit deeper.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Librarian: Well done! Here's the library key, be careful!
dialogues.hostile: Librarian: Guards, we found something fishy here!

librarian.name: The Librarian
librarian.description: A corrupt librarian who is keeping the Necronomicon for their own purposes.

dialogues.before_talk: Librarian: Hello there. I need your help on my necronomicon chapter... You know how it's going to go down...
dialogues.after_talk: Librarian: Still looking for the Necronomicon? How quaint.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Guard: Guards! This man stole the necronomicon, lock him up!
dialogues.hostile: Guard: The necronomicon is missing from my desk. Guard: We need to get this back.
